failure.observed: Room selection left the cluster experientially static because selection immediately descended the viewport away from the still-manipulable spatial scene.
failure.contractContradiction: ROOM_SELECTED is declared as a cluster manipulation state and therefore may not transition the visitor into a presentation state that prevents continued direct manipulation.

repairLaw.roomSelection: Selection commits room identity and action availability without forcing viewport departure from the Compass scene.
repairLaw.continuity: ROOM_SELECTED retains direct cluster drag, preview, commit, settlement and repeated manipulation until explicit navigation or an explicit return action changes state.
repairLaw.presentation: Selected-room information may update in the coupled context surface, but must not replace spatial manipulation with automatic document traversal.

qualificationLaw.rule: Every state declared manipulable must execute representative input and prove controller-state change, renderer-state change, and visible geometry change.

required: no Compass navigation, route, controller or pointer authority is acquired
